instruction: Candid studio photograph, full shot at eye-level. In an indoor dance studio with a checkered floor and vertical light tubes, the woman with short black bob hair (R12) and the brunette woman with long dark brown hair (R13) stand side-by-side. Both wear red, white, and yellow cheerleading crop tops, white skirts, white knee-high socks, and white sneakers. The woman with short black bob hair (R12) stands on the left, body turned right, looking back over her shoulder with a smile. The brunette woman (R13) stands on the right, body turned left, looking back over her shoulder with a smile. They hold orange metallic pom-poms at their sides. The scene is lit by bright natural light from windows and warm background light tubes.
